requirement_summary: Citizen registers with name and username to access the system.
prompt: Execute a happy path registration for a new citizen user. Provide a unique username, valid email, and full name. Verify the response indicates successful creation and returns a session token or confirmation ID.
cleanup_strategy: Delete created resources or restore their previous state.
rationale: Validates the entry point for all citizen interactions and ensures user creation logic works correctly.

requirement_summary: Citizen confirms registration with a code to activate their account.
prompt: Execute the happy path for email verification. Use the token/code returned from the signup response (or a valid mock code) and the authenticated session ID. Verify the account status changes to 'verified' or active.
setup_needed: Perform POST /sessions/signup to obtain a valid user token and verification code.
cleanup_strategy: Delete created resources or restore their previous state.
rationale: Ensures the account activation workflow functions as intended before allowing further interactions.

requirement_summary: Technical office staff assigns reports to external maintainers.
prompt: Execute a happy path assignment. First, ensure a report exists in 'Pending Approval' or 'Assigned' state (mock ID). Authenticate as 'technical office staff member'. Send a PATCH request with the external maintainer's ID (obtained from /sessions/available_staff) to assign the report.
setup_needed: Authenticate as technical office staff member.
Retrieve a list of available external maintainers via GET /sessions/available_staff to get a valid maintainer ID.
Create or locate the resource referenced by the path parameter.
cleanup_strategy: Verify the report assignment is persisted. If the test fails or needs reset, ensure the report remains in its new state for subsequent tests; no deletion required as reports are immutable by citizens.
rationale: Validates the core workflow of delegating work to external parties.

requirement_summary: External maintainer updates the status of a report assigned to them.
prompt: Execute a happy path status update. Authenticate as 'external maintainer'. Send a PATCH request to start work on an assigned report (ID from setup). Verify the status transitions correctly.
setup_needed: Ensure a report is in 'Assigned' state (can be mocked or created via staff workflow).
cleanup_strategy: Delete created resources or restore their previous state.
rationale: Validates the external maintainer's ability to progress the intervention lifecycle.

requirement_summary: Citizen attempts to register with an existing username.
prompt: Execute a negative test for duplicate registration. Attempt to POST /sessions/signup using a username that already exists in the system (from previous happy path tests). Verify the API rejects the request with an appropriate error code.
cleanup_strategy: Verify no resource was created; delete it if unexpectedly present.
rationale: Ensures data integrity by preventing duplicate user accounts.

requirement_summary: External maintainer attempts to view internal comments without access rights (Case 2 scenario).
prompt: Execute an edge case test for restricted visibility. Authenticate as 'external maintainer' who does not have internal comment access rights (per Case 2 domain rule). Attempt to GET /conversations/{conversationId}/messages. Verify that internal notes are either hidden or the response structure excludes them, while still allowing status updates.
setup_needed: Authenticate as external maintainer without specific internal comment access flags.
Create or locate the resource referenced by the path parameter.
rationale: Validates the domain rule regarding visibility of internal notes based on user role and access configuration.

requirement_summary: Citizen replies to messages from municipal operators.
prompt: Execute a stateful workflow test. First, authenticate as 'citizen' and ensure they are registered (PT01/PT27). Then, simulate receiving a message from an operator (mocked via GET /conversations/{conversationId}/messages). Finally, POST a reply message to the same conversation ID.
setup_needed: Retrieve a valid conversation ID associated with the citizen's report.
cleanup_strategy: Delete created resources or restore their previous state.
rationale: Validates the two-way communication flow between citizens and operators, which is critical for the platform's purpose.

requirement_summary: As a system administrator I want to assign roles to municipality users
prompt: Assign a single role (e.g., 'municipal public relations officer') to the authenticated user session. Use a valid role ID retrieved from /roles.
setup_needed: Authenticate as system administrator via /sessions/login or /sessions/telegram/verify.
Fetch available roles via GET /roles to obtain valid role IDs.
Create or locate the resource referenced by the path parameter.
cleanup_strategy: Delete created resources or restore their previous state.
rationale: Validates the core functionality of assigning a single role to a user session as per PT03.

requirement_summary: As a system administrator I want to modify roles to municipality users
prompt: Replace the current set of roles for the authenticated user session with a new list containing at least one role ID.
setup_needed: Authenticate as system administrator via /sessions/login or /sessions/telegram/verify.
Fetch available roles via GET /roles to obtain valid role IDs.
Create or locate the resource referenced by the path parameter.
cleanup_strategy: Delete created resources or restore their previous state.
rationale: Validates the ability to modify (replace) user roles as per PT10.

requirement_summary: As a citizen I want to provide details for my report So that the the problem is classified correctly.
prompt: Create a new report with valid details including a categoryId, description, and location. Ensure the user is authenticated as a citizen.
setup_needed: Fetch available categories via GET /categories to obtain a valid categoryId.
cleanup_strategy: Verify no resource was created; delete it if unexpectedly present (citizens cannot modify/delete, so admin must handle cleanup).
rationale: Validates the core workflow of a citizen submitting a report with classification details as per PT05.
